title: BTS FESTA 2026 Begins — 13th Anniversary Countdown Officially Opens
detail: June 1, 2026 marks the official start of BTS FESTA 2026 — the annual two-week anniversary celebration counting down to BTS's 13th debut anniversary on June 13, 2026. Big Hit Music launches the FESTA timeline on Weverse at midnight KST, revealing a schedule of exclusive content drops, behind-the-scenes footage, and fan events leading up to the Busan Asiad Main Stadium anniversary concerts on June 12–13. The 2026 FESTA is the first held during an active world tour, adding a live-concert dimension to the celebrations. Among the announced FESTA content: an official FESTA family photo (June 4), a 'Hooligan' official performance video release (June 5) coinciding with the opening of 'BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Busan' citywide experience, and a special Weverse Live session on the eve of the anniversary (June 12). BTS members are currently in transit from Las Vegas to Seoul following the conclusion of the ARIRANG World Tour North American residency. ARMY worldwide mark June 1 with dedicated streaming events for all BTS discography, coordinated social media campaigns under #BTSFesta2026, and group watches of 'BTS: The Return' on Netflix. The 13th anniversary is particularly significant as it coincides with the peak momentum of the ARIRANG World Tour — the largest stadium tour in K-pop history, projected to gross approximately $1.8 billion — and the group's full reunion after military service completion.

media.caption: BTS FESTA 2026 begins June 1 — 13th anniversary countdown to Busan Asiad Main Stadium concerts June 12–13

title: Nike By You × BTS ARIRANG Customization Experience Goes Live in 20+ Cities Worldwide
detail: June 1, 2026: the Nike By You × BTS ARIRANG customization experience officially opens in 20+ cities across the US, Europe, and Asia — including Seoul, Busan, Tokyo, Osaka, Singapore, Bangkok, Kuala Lumpur, Jakarta, Chicago, New York, Los Angeles, and London. Fans can customize Nike apparel (T-shirts, hoodies, totes) with 10 BTS-inspired motif options drawn from ARIRANG's visual identity — featuring the group's heritage calligraphy, tour logo, and member-specific design elements. The Nike.com digital experience launches simultaneously, allowing online customization globally. On launch day, Nike By You BTS ARIRANG products sell out across multiple in-store activations within hours; the Seoul and Busan retail experiences report line queues exceeding 5 hours. The full Nike × BTS ARIRANG merchandise collection (including regional exclusives and a Korea-only limited-edition ball cap) is set for a June 12 in-store drop in Seoul and Busan, timed to the debut anniversary concerts at Busan Asiad Main Stadium. US cities (Chicago, Boston, San Francisco, LA, NYC, Las Vegas) receive the collection on July 5. Simultaneously, BTS × Oreo limited-edition hotteok-flavored cookies — purple-wafer biscuits in 13 BTS-themed designs — open their presale at OREO.com/UnwrapTheCollab globally, ahead of a wider retail rollout in 80+ countries starting June 8.

media.caption: Nike By You × BTS ARIRANG customization experience launches globally on June 1, 2026 — simultaneous with BTS × Oreo hotteok cookie presale opening
